# Dice tray 1.2.0 (test version)

The example plugin, `examples/plugins/dice-tray`, at 1.2.0 for testing updates and roll back (D-072): it drops the "Roll dice" step, keeps "Roll dice and say it in chat" and "The session's best roll", allows at most 12 sides, and says its version when it loads. It isn't an example to copy.
